title: Samudaya
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Samudayadhammo samudayadhammoti bhante vuccati || || Katamo nu kho bhante samudayadhammoti || || 4 Rūpaṃ kho Rādha samudayadhammo || vedanā samudayadhammo || saññā || saṅkhārasamudayadhammo || viññāṇaṃ samudayadhammo || || 5 Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
